verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares offers 409A valuations through third-party report providers, marketed as 'faster, more accurate, and competitively-priced', and includes them in the Growth plan. That suggests valuations can be obtained via the platform, but they are partner-produced rather than native. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-platform ordering flow, valuation generated from live cap table data, audit-ready/defensibility claims, scheduled or automatic refreshed valuations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
